name: Kedar
overview: Kedar, identified as a son of Ishmael, represents both a person and a nomadic clan among the Ishmaelites, known for their flocks and commerce. Scripture portrays Kedar as dwelling in tents in the wilderness, with their prosperity and glory subject to God's sovereign judgment, as seen in the prophecy of their decline. Yet, God also promises that the flocks of Kedar will be gathered and offered in worship, indicating a future restoration and inclusion in His glory. The references to princes and commerce of Kedar highlight their significance in the ancient world, while God's call to judgment emphasizes His control over all nations.
